name: Tantei Jinguuji Saburou Series No.11: Inu to Yobareta Otoko
original_name: 探偵 神宮寺三郎 Series No.11 イヌと呼ばれた男
source:
Jinguji is asked to help a self-proclaimed novelist with ideas for new work. Detective reluctantly agrees, but at every step he needs to deal with novelist's foolish ideas on detectives.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-june-2006-h2o-footprints-in.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名自称小说家的男子请神宫寺帮忙构思新作。神宫寺虽不情愿，最终还是答应下来，可一路上都得应付这名小说家对侦探的种种愚蠢想象。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-june-2006-h2o-footprints-in.html]vndbreview[/url]]
